question: Lata Mangeshkar recorded her first playback song for a _______ film.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marathi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lata Mangeshkar recorded her first playback song for a** Marathi film.**
 
• The film was titled** "Kiti Hasaal"** and was released in **1942.**
 
• Lata Mangeshkar was only **13 years old** when she recorded her first song.
 
• The song was composed by **Master Vinayak** and the lyrics were written by **D.N. Madhok.**
 
• Lata Mangeshkar went on to become one of the **most successful playback singers** in the Indian film industry. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bengali:** Bengali films are made in the Bengali language and are primarily produced in the Indian state of **West Bengal** and the country of **Bangladesh. **
 
• **Punjabi: **Punjabi films are made in the Punjabi language and are primarily produced in the Indian state of **Punjab and the country of Pakistan.**
 
• **Tamil: **Tamil films are made in the Tamil language and are primarily produced in the Indian state of** Tamil Nadu and the country of Sri Lanka. **
 
• **Marathi:** Marathi films are made in the Marathi language and are primarily produced in the Indian state of** Maharashtra. **
